dct_description_sm: Objectives include: (1) characterize the relative importance of hydrological processes controlling contemporary pond water balances in WNP and their relations with fluctuating meteorological conditions; (2) quantify relations among hydrological, limnological and biogeochemical conditions in ponds of WNP, and how conditions differ spatially (e.g., among ecoregions), seasonally and inter-annually throughout WNP; (3) use analyses of sediment cores to reconstruct past changes in hydroecological conditions of ponds to assess the relative roles of multiple stressors (climate change, snow goose population expansion, long-distance nutrient transport); and (4) anticipate future hydroecological and biogeochemical conditions of ponds under conditions of continued warming and landscape disturbance.
dct_title_s: Hydrology, limnology, and biogeochemistry of thermokarst lakes in Wapusk National Park (Manitoba, Canada) - past and present
